requirements.text: Hosts define recurring working hours in their time zone, with date exceptions
Bookable slots are availability minus existing bookings and busy times, honoring duration and buffers
Two concurrent bookings of the same slot cannot both succeed
Slots are stored in UTC and shown in the invitee's time zone, correct across DST
Bookings outside availability, inside the minimum notice or beyond the booking horizon are rejected on the server
A confirmed booking produces a calendar invite (iCalendar) for both parties
Only the host or invitee can cancel or reschedule, and the freed slot becomes available again
